decisions.question: What unit do we show on the progress widget per media type?
options: Native units — page/chapter for books, episode for TV, hours for games
Universal percentage across all media types
Both — native unit primary, percentage secondary
decisions.selected: Both — native unit primary, percentage secondary

decisions.question: How does the user log a progress update?
options: Inline stepper directly on the item card
Modal with a slider + notes field
Quick-add bar at the top of the library
decisions.selected: Inline stepper directly on the item card

decisions.question: What does the progress widget look like?
options: Horizontal bar with numeric label on the right
decisions.selected: Horizontal bar with numeric label on the right

decisions.question: How do completed items signal completion in lists?
How do we model progress across heterogeneous media types?
options: Single polymorphic ProgressRecord with a JSON details column
One table per media type (BookProgress, TVProgress, GameProgress)
Universal float (0..1) only — discard native units
decisions.selected: Single polymorphic ProgressRecord with a JSON details column

decisions.question: What frontend pattern do we use for the progress feature?
options: MVVM — split into progress.model.ts / progress.view.tsx / progress.viewmodel.ts
Plain functional components with hooks colocated
decisions.selected: MVVM — split into progress.model.ts / progress.view.tsx / progress.viewmodel.ts
